stem.text: Structural isomerism and stereoisomerism should be considered when answering this question.
$Y$ is a gaseous hydrocarbon which decolourises aqueous bromine.
$10.0\,\text{g}$ of $Y$ occupies a volume of $3.43\,\text{dm}^{3}$ under room conditions.
How many isomeric structures are possible for $Y$?
